tips.text: Send Command: Attack through the enemy and its minions to poke. It hits again where the Ball lands, so aim so the Ball ends up on the enemy.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back, then throw Command: Attack again for quick poke.
Keep track of where the Ball is. Your abilities only affect the area around it, and it snaps back to you if you walk too far away.
Escape with Command: Dissonance while the Ball is on you. The speed boost for you and the slow on enemies chasing you make it a strong getaway.
Attach the Ball to a tanky ally with Command: Protect. It gives them extra Armor and Magic Resist, and a shield when it lands.
Put the Ball in the middle of the enemy team before you cast Command: Shockwave at level 6. It pulls them toward the Ball and knocks them up.
Attack the same enemy several times in a row. Your passive gets stronger with each hit, but switching targets resets it.

combos.name: Buffered Shockwave
combos.when: You want to pull enemies toward a spot you can't reach yet.
combos.text: Throw the ball with Command: Attack and queue Shockwave while it is flying. It fires as soon as the ball lands, so the timing is tight.

combos.name: Self-Protect poke
combos.when: The ball is left behind in lane and you want to poke again right away.
combos.text: Use Protect on yourself to pull the ball back, then throw it out again with Command: Attack. This is Riot's own harass tip.

combos.name: Dissonance escape
combos.when: You are being chased and the ball is attached to you.
combos.text: Cast Dissonance with the ball on you for a burst of speed. The field it leaves behind slows the chasers.

tips.text: Stay behind your minions so Charm hits them first; Ahri's kiss ends at the first enemy it touches.
Poke with Command: Attack when Ahri walks up to last-hit. It keeps going after a hit, so it can catch her and the minions in its path.
Once Ahri has spent Spirit Rush, trade and push harder; she has a hard time getting away from you.
If Ahri dashes in on you, answer with Command: Dissonance; it damages her and leaves her slowed.
At level 6, put the Ball on Ahri and cast Command: Shockwave when she's close. It can ruin her all-in or start yours.
Keep Command: Dissonance ready for when Akali dives in; the pulse hurts her and the field leaves her slowed.
Hold Command: Shockwave for when Akali commits. Make sure the Ball is on you or close by so the whole burst lands on her.
Poke with Command: Attack while Akali has little energy, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself.
Aim Command: Dissonance at the smoke when Akali hides in Twilight Shroud; area damage still hits her and shows where she is.
Poke with Command: Attack when Akshan walks up to last-hit; it passes through everything in its path and hits him on arrival.
Use Command: Shockwave when Akshan is close to you and you have the Ball on you or near him. It stuns him and pulls him in.
Put Command: Dissonance down when Akshan dashes in or tries to run away. Its field slows him while it lasts.
Akshan can vanish with Going Rogue near walls and brush. Stay back from them and keep the Ball out so you are not caught off guard.

comboRefs.note: Shockwave knocks enemies toward the ball, which can pull Akshan out of his swing and dive range.
Protect then Attack keeps up Command: Attack poke on Akshan, who has little to answer it from range.

tips.text: Stay out of Anivia's Flash Frost line; if you get hit, she follows up with Frostbite for big damage.
Poke her with Command: Attack from a distance, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to poke again.
Use Command: Dissonance with the Ball on you when you need to escape; it speeds you up and slows her.
Do not walk into Glacial Storm; it slows you and hurts more the longer it grows. Fight it from the edge.
Hit her egg after Rebirth if you can; with the Ball and Command: Shockwave you can often finish it.
Poke Annie with Command: Attack when she walks up to last-hit; she has to come in range of the Ball.
Watch the counter under Annie's health bar; when it lights up, stay out of her range, because her next spell stuns you.
If Annie dashes in to fight, drop Command: Dissonance to slow her and speed yourself away.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back and shield yourself against Annie's burst.
Stay spread from your allies when Tibbers is out; he burns everyone nearby, so fight away from him.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance gives speed and a slowing field to help escape once Annie's stun threatens a chase.

tips.text: Poke with Command: Attack from long range while Aurelion Sol is busy with minions, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to reuse it.
Watch for Falling Star landing on you. It lands after a delay, so step out of the area before it hits and you avoid being stunned.
Step out of the black hole from Singularity early. It drags you toward the middle, and low-health targets there die instantly.
Use Command: Dissonance to leave a slowing field behind you when you retreat from his dash, so he can't catch you.
Put the Ball on him before level 6 with Command: Attack, then use Command: Shockwave to pull him into your team's damage when he steps in close.
Hold the Ball on yourself for armor and magic resist when he is about to burst you with Breath of Light.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Aurora jumps in or lands near the Ball; the stun and pull can set up a kill.
Use Command: Attack to poke Aurora when she steps up to last-hit. It hits everything along its path.
Keep Command: Protect ready for when Aurora dives. Put the shield on yourself to take the Ball back fast and make her trade worse.
Use Command: Dissonance to slow Aurora when she runs at you or tries to get away. Place the Ball first so the pulse lands on her.
When Aurora turns invisible with Across the Veil, don't waste spells on where she was. Stay back and wait for her to show up.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance gives speed and a slowing field to help you get away when Aurora chases you.

tips.text: Poke Azir with Command: Attack from long range when his Sand Soldiers are gone or far from you. He has to stand close to his soldiers to hit back.
Step out of his Sand Soldiers' reach, because they are what deal his damage. Trade when they have expired or been sent elsewhere.
Hold Command: Shockwave for when Azir dashes in with Shifting Sands or steps close to the Ball. It knocks him toward the Ball and stuns him.
Put Command: Dissonance on the ground when Azir walks toward you. The field slows him, and you can use it to fight or to walk away.
Do not stand in Emperor's Divide's path when you cannot afford to be knocked back. Its wall also blocks you for a few seconds.

comboRefs.note: Shockwave pulls enemies toward the ball, which can drag Azir off his soldiers and out of position.

tips.text: Sidestep Sear and Pillar of Flame; Brand needs one ability to land before his stun combo starts. Pillar of Flame has a delay, so keep moving.
Trade with Command: Attack, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself for another hit. Brand's range makes long trades risky.
Use Command: Dissonance to escape when Brand is on you; it slows him and speeds you up.
Keep your Ball on you or an ally when Brand is near. Command: Protect gives a shield that softens his burst.
Stay away from your minions when Brand is near; his Conflagration spreads fire to everything close to the target.
At level 6, put the Ball on Brand and use Command: Shockwave when he steps in range; he is stunned and pulled to you.

comboRefs.note: Protect pulls the ball back so Attack can poke again, keeping up pressure on Brand's lane.

tips.text: Keep the Ball between you and Briar and poke with Command: Attack while she walks up; she has no ranged way to reach you except Head Rush.
When Briar leaps in, use Command: Dissonance on yourself to slow her and run toward your team.
Put the Ball on yourself with Command: Protect before she reaches you; the shield and extra resistances blunt her burst.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Briar is on top of you in a fight; it stuns her and pulls her toward the Ball.
When Briar is forced onto a target during Blood Frenzy, she can't steer. Kite back with the slow field and hit her with Command: Attack as she chases.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance leaves a field that slows chasers, which helps when Briar leaps in and chases you.

tips.text: Poke with Command: Attack from long range; the Ball stays behind where it landed, so aim it at Cassiopeia whenever she steps up to last-hit.
Cassiopeia is slowed in your Command: Dissonance field. Use it to cut her chase, or to run away when she steps forward.
Hold Command: Shockwave for when Cassiopeia commits. Put the Ball on her, and she is pulled in and stunned.
When Cassiopeia is close to ending a fight, put Command: Protect on yourself. It shields you and brings the Ball back.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance's speed burst and slowing field help her escape when Cassiopeia chases her.

tips.text: Poke Diana with Command: Attack from long range while she walks up. Each hit also gives her less reason to stay in lane.
Dodge Crescent Strike by stepping out of its curved path. If it hits, expect Diana to dash onto you with Lunar Rush right away.
When Diana dashes in, fire Command: Dissonance to hit her and leave her slowed. It also speeds you up while you move away.
Put the Ball on yourself before Diana arrives, so Command: Protect's shield is up and Command: Dissonance can fire right away.
Keep the Ball near you when Diana can dive. Command: Shockwave pulls her in and stuns her, and only works around the Ball.
Do not rely on Command: Shockwave alone to stop Diana. Her Pale Cascade shield soaks some damage when she comes in.
Poke Ekko with Command: Attack from long range while he walks up to last-hit; the Ball keeps travelling and hits everyone in its path.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Ekko dives in. It stuns him and pulls him toward the Ball, so put the Ball where you want him.
Use Command: Dissonance when Ekko jumps on you. It damages him and slows him, which makes it harder for him to chase or escape.
Watch for Parallel Convergence to appear on the ground and step out of the area before it goes off. Ekko only stuns you if he walks into it.
Put Command: Protect on yourself when Ekko jumps on you. The shield absorbs some of his burst.
Do not chase Ekko after he uses Chronobreak, since he returns to where he was, heals and damages you. Wait until it is on cooldown before you commit.
Aim Command: Attack through minions to hit Ezreal. It passes through enemies and keeps going, so minions don't block it.
Ezreal's Mystic Shot is a straight line that minions block. Stand so a minion is between you and him, and he will struggle to poke you.
Ezreal is fragile, so lean on him. Command: Shockwave pulls him toward the Ball and stuns him, so put the Ball on him and fire it at level 6.
Use Command: Dissonance when Ezreal blinks in close. The field slows him as he tries to get away.

comboRefs.note: Protect then Attack lets her keep poking Ezreal with Command: Attack even when the ball is left behind.

tips.text: Save Command: Shockwave for when Fizz lands from Playful; it pulls him in and stuns him, so he cannot dodge again.
Do not waste spells while Fizz is untargetable on his trident. Wait until he lands, then answer with Command: Dissonance.
Poke him with Command: Attack while he walks up to last-hit. Keep the Ball behind you so Fizz has a harder time reaching you.
Put Command: Protect on yourself when Fizz dives in. The shield and extra resistances blunt his burst.
Fizz's Chum the Waters is a long-range shark that hits harder the farther it flies. Stay away from other enemies near you so it has no easy targets.
Use Command: Dissonance to escape when he gets on you. The field slows him and speeds you up.
Keep Command: Attack on cooldown to poke Galio. His Winds of War is slow to arrive, so trade right after he uses it.
Stay away from Galio's Justice Punch range. Keep the Ball behind you so Command: Dissonance can slow him if he lunges at you.
Don't spend Command: Shockwave on a Galio charging Shield of Durand; he takes less magic damage and can taunt you right back.
Galio is slower while charging Shield of Durand, so poke him with Command: Attack then.
Stay out of the way of Hwei's slow lightning and fireball by moving sideways. Both need him to aim, so walk unpredictably when he's casting.
Rush Hwei right after he paints a Torment spell. Use Command: Attack, then Command: Dissonance when he is close, and trade while the spell is on cooldown.
Hold Command: Shockwave for when Hwei is stunned-range close. It pulls him toward the Ball, so place the Ball where your team can reach him.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to bring the Ball back fast, then follow with Command: Attack to poke Hwei.
Use Command: Dissonance to escape when Hwei roots or drags you. The speed boost and slowing field help you get away.
Keep the Ball near where Irelia will dash in. Command: Dissonance slows her and leaves a field that hurts her approach.
Stay away from minion waves she can dash through. Without minions near you, Irelia's Bladesurge has nothing to land on.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Irelia has dashed in. Don't waste it while she charges Defiant Dance, because she takes much less damage.
Use Command: Attack to poke her when her Ionian Fervor stacks are down.
Keep Command: Protect ready to shield yourself when she dashes in. It also brings the Ball back to you.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance gives you speed and slows chasers, which helps when Irelia dashes onto you.

tips.text: Poke Kassadin with Command: Attack while he is low level. He has no easy way to reach you early.
Keep Command: Dissonance ready for when Kassadin blinks in. Its slowing field helps you walk away.
Use Command: Protect on yourself for a shield when Kassadin's Force Pulse is about to land.
Once Kassadin reaches level 6, keep the Ball near you so Command: Shockwave can stun him when he blinks in.

comboRefs.note: Self-Protect poke lets Orianna re-throw the ball for Command: Attack harass against Kassadin.

tips.text: Hold Command: Shockwave for when Katarina starts Death Lotus. It stuns her and breaks the channel.
Keep the Ball on you when Katarina is close. Command: Dissonance then hits her and slows her as she dives in.
Use Command: Protect on yourself for a shield when Katarina jumps on you. It also brings the Ball back to you.
Walk away from Daggers on the ground. When she picks one up with Shunpo it lowers her cooldown, so she can attack again soon.
Poke her with Command: Attack while she waits for her cooldowns. Stay at long range so Shunpo cannot reach you.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance's speed burst and slowing field help Orianna get away when Katarina chases her.

tips.text: Stay out of Ethereal Chains' line and keep minions between you and LeBlanc. Walk away from the tether before it breaks the root on you.
When LeBlanc dashes in with Distortion, hit her with Command: Dissonance to slow her and punish her return.
Use Command: Attack to poke LeBlanc from long range while she has to wait on her cooldowns.
Save Command: Shockwave for when LeBlanc commits. It stuns her, so she cannot recast Distortion to get away.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to gain a shield when you expect LeBlanc's burst.
Poke with Command: Attack when Lissandra steps up to last-hit; it passes through minions and hits her and anything behind her.
Stay out of Ice Shard range. Standing behind your minions means the first one hit takes the slow instead of you.
Step out of the way of Glacial Path. Lissandra often recasts it to jump onto you, so keep your distance and keep Command: Dissonance ready.
Trade while Ring of Frost is on cooldown. Her root is her best answer to you walking close.
Use Command: Dissonance to run when she dives; the field slows her and speeds you up.
Stay away from her Frozen Tomb at level 6. If she targets you, you are stunned, so keep your distance and ready your Ball.
Hit Command: Shockwave when she jumps in with Glacial Path to stun her and pull her toward the Ball.
Stay out of Light Binding's line and keep minions out of its path, because it roots the first two enemies it hits. Walk to the side to dodge it.
Poke Lux with Command: Attack while she walks up to last-hit. It passes through enemies and hits again at the end.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back, then fire Command: Attack again for repeated poke.
Lux is fragile, so put the Ball on her and cast Command: Shockwave to pull her in. Do it when your team can follow up.
Leave the Ball outside Lucent Singularity's area and don't walk into it, since it slows you. Walk around it.
When Lux casts Final Spark, a warning line appears first. Step out sideways, and don't stay in a long line with your team.
If Lux has used Light Binding, trade with Command: Dissonance and Command: Attack, because her next one is on a long cooldown.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance's speed and slow field help you get away if Lux roots you or slows you with her zone.

tips.text: Poke with Command: Attack from long range while Malzahar farms; the Ball keeps going after it hits, so line up the minions and him together.
Hit Malzahar with auto attacks and abilities when his Void Shift is down. It cuts his damage taken a lot until he takes a hit.
Step out of Call of the Void when the portals appear; it silences you and stops you from casting.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions. When they die, it jumps to the nearest enemy, which can be you.
Look for Command: Shockwave at level 6 once Malzahar has spent his spells. Pull him in and kill him before Void Shift returns.
Use Command: Dissonance to escape when Malzahar closes in. The field leaves him slowed and speeds you up.
Hold Command: Dissonance until Mel's Rebuttal is spent, or at least don't count on her missiles landing while it is up; Rebuttal destroys enemy projectiles.
Throw Command: Attack when Mel's Rebuttal is on cooldown, because Rebuttal destroys projectiles such as the Ball.
Stay out of a straight line with Mel; if Solar Snare hits you, you are rooted and her barrage follows.
Back off when you are low on health after trading; Mel's Overwhelm stacks can execute you with her next hit.
Use Command: Shockwave at level 6 when Mel is close to the Ball; it pulls her in and stuns her.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Naafiri dives at you; it stuns her and pulls her and her packmates in, so you can follow up with your other spells.
Poke her with Command: Attack from long range while she is cautious, and pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself.
When Naafiri closes in, drop Command: Dissonance on yourself; it damages her and leaves a field that slows her while you run.
Keep the Ball on yourself and hold Command: Protect for when she starts her dash, so the shield and bonus resistances soften the burst.

comboRefs.note: Pulling the ball back with Protect then Q lets you keep poking Naafiri's lane presence.

tips.text: Keep the Ball on yourself or close by when Qiyana threatens to dash in; Command: Dissonance then slows her as she arrives.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Qiyana dashes onto you with Audacity; it stuns her and pulls her into the Ball.
Poke with Command: Attack when she steps up to gather an element, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself.
Qiyana turns invisible in brush with the grass element. Stay back from brush, and do not walk in blind.
Keep Command: Protect ready as a shield for when she dashes in. It also damages her if the Ball passes through her.

comboRefs.note: Protect then Attack lets Orianna keep poking Qiyana from range with Command: Attack.

tips.text: Keep the Ball near the lane so Command: Dissonance and Command: Attack hit Ryze when he walks up to trade.
Do not let Ryze put Spell Flux on you before Rune Prison. Once he has, he can root you and hit hard.
If Ryze gets close, put the Ball on you and use Command: Shockwave to stun him and pull him in.
Use Command: Dissonance to slow Ryze when you need to leave. Its field also speeds you up.
Stay out of Abscond range and watch for the dash; Sylas follows with Abduct, which stuns and knocks you up. Keep your distance when it is ready.
Poke Sylas with Command: Attack from long range when he steps up to the wave. He has to commit to reach you.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back and shield you when Sylas dives in, then fire Command: Attack as he closes.
Put the Ball near you before Sylas arrives, so Command: Dissonance can hit him and slow him as he lands.
Sylas can steal Command: Shockwave with Hijack at level 6. Position the Ball carefully before you fight, and watch what he does with it.
Sylas heals with Kingslayer when he is low, so do not chase a hurt Sylas. Burst him down fully or back off.
Stay out of Scatter the Weak's line when Syndra has a Dark Sphere out; a pushed Dark Sphere stuns you, so step sideways.
Trade with Command: Attack when Syndra's Dark Sphere is on cooldown, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to poke again.
Push at Syndra after she uses Scatter the Weak, since its cooldown is long and she has no way to knock you off.
If Syndra gets close, use Command: Dissonance to slow her and speed yourself away.
Use Command: Shockwave in a fight to pull Syndra in and stun her; it is a strong answer when she steps close.
Stay out of Taliyah's Seismic Shove and Unraveled Earth combo; if you get knocked into the stones, you take damage and get stunned.
Walk to the side when Taliyah throws Threaded Volley; the rocks fly in a fixed direction.
Poke Taliyah with Command: Attack, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to poke again.
Use Command: Dissonance to leave when Taliyah closes in; the field slows her and speeds you up.
Taliyah's Weaver's Wall can't be cast right after she takes damage from you, so keep her hurt to stop her escaping or roaming.
At level 6, put the Ball on yourself or near Taliyah, then use Command: Shockwave when she steps in; she is stunned and pulled to the Ball.
Keep Command: Dissonance ready for when Talon leaps in; the field slows him, and you move faster inside it to get away.
Use Command: Protect on yourself when Talon dives. The shield and the extra resistances from the Ball help you survive his burst.
Poke Talon with Command: Attack while he last-hits. Pull the Ball back to you with Command: Protect to repeat it.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Talon commits to you. It stuns him and pulls him toward the Ball, so keep the Ball on you when he jumps in.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance's speed burst and slowing field help her get away if Talon leaps onto her.
Protect then Attack lets her poke again at once, keeping the ball ready against Talon.

tips.text: Dodge Wild Cards early, since you can't afford many hits. Step out of the fan's cone sideways.
When Twisted Fate starts shuffling Pick a Card, back off. His Gold Card stuns you and sets up a follow-up.
Poke him with Command: Attack and pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to poke again quickly.
When Destiny goes off, leave the lane if you are low, since he may be teleporting to you.
Use Command: Dissonance with the Ball on you to escape a gank. The slowing field helps.
Keep your distance from Veigar when you are low on health, since Primordial Burst hurts more the lower you are.
Watch for the Dark Matter warning and keep moving. It lands after a short delay.
Do not run into the edge of Event Horizon. If you stay inside the cage you can still move and attack.
Poke Veigar with Command: Attack when he steps up to last-hit. Hit him with the Ball on the way out and back.
If Veigar jumps on you, use Command: Dissonance to slow him and run away.
Use Command: Shockwave to pull Veigar into your team when he is stuck near your Ball.
Keep the Ball on a spot where Vex must walk when she goes for a last-hit, then hit it with Command: Attack for poke.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Vex steps in close. It stuns her and pulls her toward the Ball.
Step out of Vex's Looming Darkness and keep your distance. Her Mistral Bolt is easy to sidestep when you watch her cast.
Put Command: Dissonance down as you retreat when Vex jumps in. The field slows her and speeds you up.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back for a shield when Vex's Personal Space shout is about to hit you.
Stay out of Viktor's Siphon Power range and poke him with Command: Attack from far away. His shield makes trading up close worse for you.
Step out of Gravity Field quickly. Staying inside gets you slowed and then stunned.
If Viktor is stuck in a Gravity Field or an Arcane Storm, use Command: Dissonance to run away. It speeds you up and slows him.
Leave the Ball where it will catch Viktor, then use Command: Shockwave when he walks into it. Do this when he is trying to trade.
Sidestep Hextech Ray, since it travels in a straight line. Be careful with the delayed blast it leaves behind once he has upgraded it.
Poke Vladimir with Command: Attack as he walks up to farm; it hits everything along its path.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Vladimir uses Sanguine Pool, since he can't be hit while pooled.
Use Command: Dissonance to escape if he gets on top of you; the field slows him and speeds you up.
Kill or escape Vladimir before Hemoplague finishes, since it heals him for each champion it hit.
Step up and trade when Xerath has just used Shocking Orb or Arcanopulse; Orianna wins close fights better than long-range ones.
Sidestep Shocking Orb by moving out of its line, and stay near minions that could block it. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Walk side to side when you see Xerath charging Arcanopulse; the beam is hardest to land on someone moving sideways.
Poke with Command: Attack, then pull the Ball back with Command: Protect on yourself to repeat it.
Use Command: Dissonance when Xerath is slowing you with Eye of Destruction; the field speeds you up and slows him if he steps in.
At level 6, put the Ball on Xerath and use Command: Shockwave when he is in reach; it stuns him and drags him toward the Ball.
Move away or toward his Rite of the Arcane circles as the shots land; the shots land after a delay, so walk out of the marked spot.
Keep the Ball between you and Xin Zhao and slow him with Command: Dissonance when he charges in.
Poke with Command: Attack from long range. Xin Zhao has to use Audacious Charge to reach you, so be ready to answer it.
Use Command: Protect on yourself for a shield when Xin Zhao lunges at you.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Xin Zhao is on top of you. It stuns him and pulls him in, which breaks his Three Talon Strike.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance gives speed and its field slows chasers, which helps when Xin Zhao charges in.

tips.text: Keep Command: Shockwave for when Yasuo dashes in or lands a knock up; it pulls him in and stuns him so your team can kill him.
Do not rely on Command: Attack into his Wind Wall; the wiki says the Ball may drop when it hits the wall, so wait for the wall to fade.
Poke him with Command: Attack while he last-hits; it keeps going through minions to hit him, and the first hit does the most damage.
Use Command: Dissonance when he dashes at you; the field slows him and speeds you up as you back away.
Put the Ball on yourself with Command: Protect when he dives; the shield helps you survive his burst.
Poke him with Command: Attack from long range while he walks up to last-hit; the Ball keeps flying after it hits.
Save Command: Shockwave for when Yone dashes in with Fate Sealed or Mortal Steel; it stuns him and pulls him to the Ball.
When Yone gets close, use Command: Dissonance to slow him and speed yourself up so you can walk away.
Use Command: Protect on yourself to pull the Ball back for armor and magic resist and a shield when he threatens to dive on you.
Do not fight him in his Soul Unbound; his damage is repeated when it ends, so back off until his body returns.
Poke Zed with Command: Attack when he walks up to last-hit; the ball hits everything along its path and where it lands.
Hold Command: Shockwave until Zed jumps in with Death Mark. It pulls him in and stuns him, which makes his mark harder to use.
Use Command: Dissonance when Zed closes in. It deals damage, leaves a field that slows him, and speeds you up to escape.
Keep the ball on you or on a nearby ally. Command: Protect gives you a shield and some defenses to survive his burst.
Zed is weakest right after he uses Living Shadow, so punish him with Command: Attack then.
Stay out of Zoe's long Paddle Star range when you can; the star hits harder the further it flies, so close fights cost you less.
Keep moving and watch for Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If you are stunned or asleep, Zoe's follow-up damage is far larger.
Hit Zoe with Command: Attack while she stands still after Portal Jump; she cannot move then and must return to her start spot.
Use Command: Shockwave on Zoe once she has used her bubble or Portal Jump. She has little way to get out of it.
Put Command: Protect on an ally or yourself to get the Ball back fast and poke again with Command: Attack.

comboRefs.note: Dissonance gives speed and a slowing field, helping Orianna escape when Zoe's bubble or portal pressure chases her.
